subject: BrightLeaf onboarding: console walkthrough + API enablement — slot options

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightLeaf onboarding: console walkthrough + API enablement — slot options

Hi Alex / Jordan —

Thanks again for the time on Friday. As discussed, we'd like to run a 60–75 minute onboarding session that covers:
- Console walkthrough (dashboards, per-route/model usage, tracing hooks) — 30 min
- API enablement + auth keys, environment & sample requests — 20–30 min
- Q&A + next steps / mutual action plan — 10–15 min

Proposed slots (all PT):
1) Tue Aug 3, 10:00–11:15
2) Wed Aug 4, 09:00–10:15
3) Wed Aug 4, 14:00–15:15

Please pick which works best and call out any additional attendees we should include (engineering, SRE, procurement). I attached a short agenda and a prep doc with what we’ll need from your side (console account list, sample prompts, any IP policy notes).

If none of those work, tell me two alternative windows and Diego (copied) will lead the technical portion.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you up and running.

—
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0118
Redwood Inference

Hi Soojin —

Really excited to get this scheduled. Two quick items: we have an executive all-hands that conflicts with Tue Aug 3 morning, so that slot won't work for our VP. Could we prioritize Wed Aug 4? We prefer the 09:00–10:15 PT slot if Diego is available.

Also, quick question for Diego: for the API enablement, can you confirm the recommended auth setup? We plan to use per-service API keys scoped to our staging cluster — do you have a short checklist for key rotation and least-privilege scopes?

Attaching our internal attendee list (names + roles) — Jordan will add anyone else from IT.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Chen
Senior Product Manager, BrightLeaf Analytics
alex.chen@brightleaf.io | +1 206-555-0147

Hi Alex —

Thanks — Wed Aug 4, 09:00 PT works for me. I'll plan for a 75-minute session to give some breathing room for hands-on API calls. Expectations and quick prep from my side: 
- Please provide two example prompts (preferably one short, one long) and a small sample dataset or text blob we can use for the live demo.
- Add the Redwood service account emails you'd like as viewers/admins in the console (instructions in the prep doc).
- If you want least-privilege API keys: we recommend creating scoped keys per service with token TTL = 24 hours for staging; we can demo a rotate/replace flow during the session.

Concrete schedule for the call (Aug 4, 09:00–10:15 PT):
09:00–09:05 — quick intros and goals
09:05–09:35 — console walkthrough (Marissa will demo usage dashboards & tracing)
09:35–09:55 — API enablement (I’ll show key creation, example requests, and live infer calls)
09:55–10:10 — hands-on: BrightLeaf runs two sample prompts against staging model
10:10–10:15 — next steps / mutual action items (MAL)

I'll create a temporary testing API key for the demo and revoke it after. If you want us to use a key you issue, please drop it into the secure channel (or we'll use our temp key).

Forwarding Alex's reply below for context.

I’ve penciled in Wed Aug 4, 09:00–10:15 PT on the Redwood calendar and invited the attendees I have from your earlier list (Jordan, Samir, Priya). I’ll record the session and upload the recording to our shared Drive folder for your team.

A couple of quick items for you before the call: 
- Please confirm which environment you want us to use for the demo (staging vs. integration). We recommend staging for safety.

Thanks everyone — Wed Aug 4, 09:00 PT confirmed.

We’ll plan to use staging. Attendees from BrightLeaf: Jordan Hale (Head of DevOps), Samir Patel (SRE), Priya Rao (Platform eng). I’ll forward any additional names to Marissa.

Diego — we’ll share two sample prompts and a small sample text bundle by EOD today. Regarding keys, we can either let you use the temp key or we will issue a scoped staging key ahead of time. I think we'd prefer issuing the key so we can audit the traffic in our systems; I’ll send the key via the secure channel you mentioned.

Please send a calendar invite with the Zoom link + an agenda. Also, can someone include a short note in the invite about the recording and where it will be stored? I'll loop in procurement if we need any additional paperwork after the session.

Appreciate it — see you Wednesday.

—
Alex Chen
Senior Product Manager, BrightLeaf Analytics
